The '''Drada system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Halthor sector/Legends|Halthor sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained a [[Unidentified Dradan homeworld|planet]] that was the homeworld of the [[Dradan/Legends|Dradans]].
